answer: A ferrous-weight stake works like a falcon watching from above: each identity must lock a bond that is slashed if it vouches for a fake, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand forfeitable bonds. A newcomer starts as a small ember of trust, with a tiny spending limit, and earns more only through a history of honest attestations. An attacker can still buy in, but each fake costs real money and yields almost nothing until it behaves, so sybil farming stops paying.
